title: American Military Musuem

services.name: Rentals & Film Productions
services.desc: The Museum has been working with major motion picture studios and production agencies since the early 1960s. We have 7 acres of props, vehicles, and equipment that can be rented out for movies, photo shoots, television shows, theater productions, YouTube, trade shows, etc. For more than five decades, our organization has played a significant role in a wide variety of video and film productions. Throughout this extensive period, our vehicles have made numerous video appearances, contributing to the creative vision of filmmakers and production teams. services.name: 1/4 Ton 4x4 Truck “Jeep”
services.desc: The Jeep was to be found in every theatre of World War II and was used by every allied army. It also served in the Korean Conflict and during the Vietnam War by the French. A total of 650,00 were produced from 1940 to 1945. It remained in service, relatively unchanged until the middle 1950’s, after which it was replaced by improved models.
